local_patches.summary: Non-warehouse-source detection for Power BI tables sourced from a Fabric Dataflow / Lakehouse / OneLake / Dataverse / file connector (pbiDetectNonWarehouseSource, wired into the table-path-resolution fallback and exported). Applied by hand directly onto this bundle (source_commit 2f8c6cd) rather than via tools/vendor-converters.sh because upstream converter-source does not yet have this change (its source_commit predates this feature and there is no newer upstream commit to re-vendor from). Present ONLY in this vendored bundle: a naive re-vendor from any upstream commit before this lands there would silently DROP the ⛔ nonWarehouseSourcedTables detection and stats field, breaking the migrate-powerbi.rb non_warehouse_source checkpoint decision and reopening the field-reported failure this PR fixes (a placeholder warehouse path shipped with no signal that it needs land-then-repoint). Port pbiDetectNonWarehouseSource (and its call site in convertPowerBIToSigma's table-path fallback) upstream to converter-source's src/powerbi.ts, then re-vendor and retire this entry.
